name: Proterguride
summary: Proterguride, also known as 6-propylterguride or 6-propyl-9,10-dihydrolisuride, is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor and antiparkinsonian agent which was never marketed. It is closely structurally related to certain other ergolines like terguride and lisuride. Besides dopamine receptors, the drug also interacts with serotonin, adrenergic, and histamine receptors.
